title: A1 Swaara v1.0.3 - Artist Screen & Theme Harmonization
changelog:
- Completely overhauled Artist Screen and global theme to match A1 Swaara Obsidian & Emerald design
- Replaced legacy purple theme with deep obsidian black background and emerald accents
- Modernized Shuffle button, radio action button, and tab rail indicators with dark glass styling
- Enhanced artist circular avatar with proportional sizing and ambient glow
- Clean white and emerald typography across songs, albums, and singles sections
